findings.likely_cause_hypothesis: This is not verified, because I did not read code. The text order looks correct, which suggests the bidi isolation works but the space is on the wrong side. An inline-start margin on an English label resolves to its left edge, while the gap is needed on its right, between it and the Hebrew label. Margin on the inline-end side, or margin computed in the parent's direction, would likely fix it.
